name: Five Codex QA fixes, 2026-11-15
scope: Authorized source JSON, test scripts, bundle and embedded index only. Existing workspace changes preserved. No testdata changes. No commit.

fixes.details: Capture all three generations, cache/request/active-letter identities, mask ownership and global project under mutex. Revalidate after source read and destination write before clearing dirty/masks or invalidating destination caches. Any change retains newer RAM and metadata.

Flush independent bank snapshots using op 5. Retain the original transaction stamp across all three banks and all unlocked I/O windows. Revalidate after each write and before final reset; abort leaves banks and dirty state intact. Real caller retry persists edits and resets successfully. Write-failure abort retained.

Inline clear acquires the sequencing mutex through poly clear, generation/masks/dirty updates and native present/dirty store. Held transpose alias owns the mutex across the native held-note operation and installed poly update. Already-protected vtable clear and whole-pattern transpose paths acquire no additional lock.

Installed tie/slide hook checks 127-entry occupancy before canceling the old off. Full ring skips to 0x080217A4 with original off preserved; one spare usable slot retains normal replacement. Real lookup, cancel, insert, sorting and drain tested with one pending off plus 126 CC events.

Save/project functions allocate 88-byte aligned frames: 84-byte transaction stamp and one result/op word in the final four bytes. This replaces all one-word stack pushes around mutex calls. Both functions reserve at least eight temporary bytes beyond the 80-byte metadata capture. Runtime checks assert SP modulo 8 equals zero at every modeled mutex and sidecar FatFS call.

explicit_read_reservation.note: Independent SD snapshot/read buffer, including the oversize-file detection byte at 0x1000ed80; cwd starts at 0x1000ef00.

preserved.excluded_module_tests: Assemble/install pulled sources only in isolated emulator fixtures and assert they remain absent from the flash bundle.

new_installed_hooks.note: unprotected held transpose alias holds sequencer mutex through native/poly mutation and metadata
tie/slide admission before off cancellation; full ring preserves original off and skips replacement

changed_routines.purpose: inline clear lock and native metadata
